description: Claims extracted from the 60 frozen answer files (data/raw/). Each instance quotes the answer verbatim; unique claims collapse instances that a reader would check as one unit. Frequency, stability and instability_cause are computed from the instances. kemira_presence records whether Kemira was named in each open-question answer, separately from claims. Extraction involves judgment (README limit 5); borderline calls are noted on the instance.
